svg.title: Account and Project access administration responsibility
svg.desc: System Management creates and activates Linh's account without product access. A Project Administrator separately admits Linh to P-100 and its mechanical Group. Access Policy combines Group membership with a Design Engineer Role Assignment at P-100 Scope, after which the product Module still applies its business gates.
